note: Read by tools/export_map_paths.py. The name each actuator is shown by on the map page, and the reference its card links to. These are display choices, not data: nothing here comes from, or goes into, data/records. "records" is keyed by record id. Each entry holds "name" (the label on the map: what the actuator is called, with the part that tells it from its neighbours), "detail" (one plain sentence for the card), "name_from" ("authors" for the name the paper uses, "field" for the field's general name for that type of actuator with our own distinguishing part, "description" for a plain description of ours where the source gives no name), "name_source" (where the name was taken from) and "reference" (a key of "references", or null for our own simulated records, which are not published). "references" holds each paper once: the full citation, the DOI, the link (always https://doi.org/ followed by the DOI), an open copy where the curves were read from one, and the date and way the citation was checked. No name is invented: where a source gives no name for the actuator, the entry is a plain description and says so. An actuator with no entry here is shown by its record id.
